conventions.name: harness-core-modules
conventions.description: Each harness adapter directory carries the shared adapter modules.

must.name: harness-usage-module
must.description: Require usage.ts for adapters that track usage. Claude declares usage as null in the harness registry.

must.name: harness-launch-module
must.description: Require launch.ts for adapter launch preparation. Claude uses the dispatcher and shared harness launch-argument renderers.

must.name: harness-meta-module
must.description: Require meta.ts for passive transcript metadata. Codex owns this in rollout.ts.

must.name: harness-tui-module
must.description: Require tui.ts for pane parsers. Pi declares tui as null in the harness registry.

conventions.name: web-hook-export
conventions.description: Each web hook module exports the hook named by its filename.

conventions.name: component-named-export
conventions.description: Prefer a filename-matching export for PascalCase React modules. Grouped components and historical entry-point names make this advisory. Lowercase helper modules are outside this convention.

conventions.name: skill-document
conventions.description: Each shipped skill directory has a SKILL.md entry point.

conventions.name: terminal-backend-factory
conventions.description: Backend modules export a factory named after the file and backend kind. The registry, launch target helpers, and system default resolver consume backend types.

conventions.name: task-source-adapter-export
conventions.description: TaskSourceImpl modules export the camelCase name of the file. The index adapts implementations for registry use.

conventions.name: persona-operator-documents
conventions.description: Require the operator briefs and guide in personas/ even if the directory is removed.

conventions.name: persona-markdown-location
conventions.description: Persona sources and briefs are Markdown files directly under personas/.

conventions.name: repository-plan-entry
conventions.description: Each repository plan directory has a plan.md entry point. Check execution runtime is a historical phase bundle. Conversation search, Foreman review recommendation, and the persistent working indicator contain only historical mockups.

conventions.name: playwright-spec-location
conventions.description: Playwright specs use the .spec.ts suffix and live under e2e/specs/ so the dashboard test runner discovers them.
